oxlintCyclomaticParity.note: Side check: oxlint `complexity` (max 0) vs ESLint core `complexity` (classic), joined on function start/end line. Residual mismatches are mostly join ambiguity (oxlint also reports class-field initializers spanning the same lines as a class-field arrow).

calibration.note: Hand-written cases (calibration/*.ts[x]) used to pin down what each implementation counts. Biome reveals only scores >= 2 (maxAllowedComplexity minimum is 1).
